function.arguments: {"observation": "The `arm` (treatment vs control) is strongly imbalanced with respect to `severity`: control group has 332 mild, 106 moderate, 21 severe; treatment group has only 58 mild, 100 moderate, 95 severe. This violates the assumption of comparability between groups. The treatment arm has far fewer mild patients and many more severe patients. Since treatment was assigned by clinician discretion (not randomised), this imbalance is expected — clinicians likely gave the drug to sicker patients.", "implication": "A raw difference in response rates between treatment and control is confounded by severity. The observed effect could be due to severity, not treatment. We must adjust for severity — either by stratifying, standardising, or modelling it — before reporting a treatment effect. Reporting a raw difference would be misleading and potentially reverse the true effect."}
function.name: note_finding
